channel.title: Stanislav Peev - SEO & AI Search (GEO) Research
channel.description: Original research and data reports on AI search visibility, GEO (generative engine optimization) and SEO - by Stanislav Peev, independent SEO consultant and AI search specialist.

item.title: How reliable is AI visibility tracking? A 60-query experiment
item.description: An original experiment: the same four buyer questions run 60 times across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Which engine you track moved a brand's measured AI visibility 2.3x more than the model's own run-to-run randomness, and two engines recommended a tool the third never named once. Full method, limitations and raw dataset published.

item.title: SEO Profy: what a real SEO professional does and how to hire one
item.description: A working SEO professional's guide for US businesses: what the job includes in 2026 (including AI search), when DIY is enough, engagement models, what business owners really say about hiring SEO help, and the red flags to walk away from.

item.title: How often AI gets business information wrong: 2026 statistics
item.description: 93% of businesses have at least one fact wrong or missing in AI answers. Source-verified statistics on how often ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity misstate business hours, phone numbers and services - with a 10-prompt self-audit protocol to test your own business.
